# Pierson Norris

> Personal site of Pierson Norris (goes by Pierce): Finance student at Elon University (class of 2027), founder of True North Services LLC (Chicago North Shore exterior services), AI intern at Screencastify (Jun–Aug 2026), president of Elon's AI & ET Club. This file is the machine-readable summary; the site's HTML is fully semantic and crawlable.

This site is actively maintained (scaffold live 2026-08-23). Content below is kept in sync with the site at each milestone.

## Who he is

- Founder & CEO, True North Services LLC (2026; grew from Oasis Exterior Cleaning, founded May 2023): 50+ clients and five-figure revenue in the first summer, +68% customer growth. Incorporated the company in spring 2026 on a manager-contractor model with a written operations and risk framework, documented pricing floors ($100 minimum job, 30%+ manager margin target, signed client agreement above $500), a mandatory three-form workflow feeding one master sheet, and a head-manager training program he wrote himself.
- AI Intern, Screencastify (Jun 9 – Aug 7, 2026): mapped 7 workflows across 6 departments in 48 hours via one written diagnostic prompt; shipped 3 live automation fixes, including one cutting a 4–8 hr/week finance task to under 15 minutes. Also built Castify OS — three internal AI modules live in nine weeks (a proposal generator that took proposals from 30 minutes to 5, an approval-gated outbound email agent, and a traffic dashboard that breaks out AI-assistant referrals as their own channel).
- Elon University: Finance major, minors in Entrepreneurship and Mandarin Chinese (conversational). Team lead, Elon AI Hub (since it started, Feb 2025). President, AI & ET Club (Aug 2025 – present).
- Self-directed investor since 2020; builds his own tools, including a private portfolio tracker.

## Pages

Live now:

- /jar/: Firefly Jar — Pierson Norris's Obsidian notes as fireflies in a mason jar. One firefly per note; bigger and brighter means more linked. Lift the lid, then press a firefly to read it.
- /atlas/: knowledge atlas read as a night sky — what Pierson Norris has learned running True North Services LLC, interning at Screencastify, investing since 2020, and building his own tools. One star per note, one jar per domain, and a telescope that draws the links between them. Curated public data (assets/js/atlas-data.js) traced to docs/CONTENT.md; it is not the private vault and carries no client names, portfolio values or former-employer figures.
- /athletics/: a public snapshot of how athletics and training fit into Pierson Norris's life, with aggregate workout data from 2023–2025 (Hevy export; yearly totals only, no individual workouts).
